ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Finance_Approval_Required__c = true, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( Finance_Approval_Status__c)), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Status__c,"Requested"), ISPICKVAL( Finance_Approval_Status__c ,"Rejected"), ISPICKVAL( Event_Type__c, '') ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Event_Status__c) ,"Planning" ), ISCHANGED(Event_Status__c) , NOT(ISPICKVAL( Event_Status__c ,"Cancelled")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Event Status cannot be set to “Activation” as “Finance Approval Status” is not Approved ‘Sign Off Status’ must be ‘Approved’ in order to move to any other status except Cancelled
